operator: Only replace the incidence-map learner of the existing dynamic SO(2) token NSD. Shared 384->32 projection and 72->32->1 Phi unchanged. For each node concatenate its 36D descriptor and its unweighted closed-neighborhood descriptor mean; predict a single SO(2) frame Q_i. Restrictions at every incidence of i equal Q_i; T_ij=Q_i^T Q_j. Recompute frames at the same four layers0/3/6/9. All other confidence conductance, degree+1 normalization, mixers, ELU, finite steps and observed-token/context anchors unchanged. Both feature and label tokens still share geometry; no simultaneous label-only change.
training: Fresh original public initialization, exactly same named parameter count and initialization as previous dynamic arm for each seed; same 512 saved synthetic train episodes, schedule and1024successful CE updates. Same optimizer/learning-rate/AMP settings. No additional loss, teacher, PCFI warmup, real optimization or validation-label fitting. Original models/checkpoints remain immutable and are reused as comparisons.
evaluation: New64syntheticbasegraphs of the same family; all checkpoints including existing comparisons reevaluated on identical new episodes. Old train/dev and real banks reused by reference with SHA validation. Real4graphs are development reuse, not new independent validation. Primary missing-query accuracy averaged four masks and three fixed training seeds within base graph; paired bootstrap5000 graphs. Fixed-source2/8/full/zero-source partitions and NLL/Brier secondary.
gates: Node-frame must beat identity and dynamic on synthetic primary with each graph-paired95CI lower>0 and exceed pcfi100 point accuracy; homo node-PCFI lowerCI>-0.02. Real heterophily mean node>identity,dynamic,pcfi100,nativePCFI while homo harm versusPCFI<=0.02. Existing negativeLP is a strong comparison floor and required for universalheterophilyclaim. Report static comparison separately. No post-test architecture/loss/budget tuning.
limits: SO(2)subset, not arbitrary O(d), no guaranteed real improvement/feature recovery. Path independence only within a fixed-frame linear operator; nonlinear finite PFN dynamics are not gauge-equivalent to ordinary PCFI. Node-wise constraint also changes map conditioning from edge endpoint pair to own+neighbor summary. Same total parameters do not imply identical function capacity. Reused checkpoint training/evaluation numerical variation must be measured and disclosed. Prior synthetic/real results are already known; new test graphs are not new generator family or unseen real graphs.
